statements.text: It was my first time in this coffee shop, I never saw the defendant before. I was just in line behind him, waiting to order my coffee when I saw him trying to pay with that bill.
statements.press_response: I didn't know what to think at first, I thought maybe he was joking or something.

statements.text: I only was near the defendant's pockets for a moment, i was tying my shoes
statements.press_response: I don't remember seeing anyone near his pockets, I was just focused on tying my shoes.

statements.text: I went away after that, I didn't want to get involved. I didn't even know the defendant was being arrested until I heard the commotion outside.
